items.html: The matter is that it is known that the name Elokim has one hundred and twenty combinations in it, divided into four parts. They are: the first name Elokim, comprising thirty combinations in the first Sefira; the second name Elokim, comprising thirty combinations in the second Sefira; the name Elokim, comprising thirty combinations in the third Sefira; and the name Elokim, comprising thirty combinations in the fourth Sefira.
